title: Home aide: woman 86 confused over two days, burning when she pees, running warm

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what's the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm a home aide at 77 Palm Avenue, I'm here with my client, Mrs. Feld. She's 86.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She's been getting more and more mixed up since Friday. Today she thinks it's 1985 and she's asking for her mother. When she talks it doesn't really hang together.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She's been running warm, and yesterday she said it burns when she pees. She's barely drinking anything.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Any weakness on one side, or her face looking different?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, she's moving both arms and legs fine, her face looks like her face. She's just foggy and tired.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was she last her normal self?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thursday evening she was sharp as a tack, we did a crossword together.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Keep offering her sips of water.

facts.value: running warm, burns when she pees
